description.zh: 需要删除的管道ID。可以通过**MPS控制台** > **全局设置** > **管道**获取。
description.en: The ID of the MPS queue that you want to delete. To obtain the ID of the MPS queue, you can log on to the **MPS console** and choose **Global Settings** > **Pipelines** in the left-side navigation pane.

descriptions.zh:
本接口一次只能删除一个管道。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to delete only one MPS queue at a time.

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).
